name: blockchainlab-index
summary: Nightly machine-readable code index of the curated Blockchains forks: per-repo catalog, every contract/module/circuit as a component with functions, licence and pinned raw URL, capability taxonomy, int8 embeddings, static search shards and SQLite FTS5. Feeds the composers.

entrypoints.name: components/<slug>.json
entrypoints.usage: per-fork component list (path, kind, functions, events, SPDX, pragma, caps, raw URL)

entrypoints.name: index.sqlite
entrypoints.usage: FTS5: select slug,path,name from components where components match 'paymaster'

entrypoints.name: indexer/compose.py
entrypoints.usage: BL_INDEX=. python3 indexer/compose.py plan "<idea>" --json plan.json && python3 indexer/compose.py fetch plan.json out/

entrypoints.name: taxonomy/capabilities.json
entrypoints.usage: capability ids, synonyms, standards, match rules, licence policy

outputs.name: catalog
outputs.description: repo records incl. category, licence, commit, packages, install commands, reuse note

compatible_with.how: keeps the indexed forks current; index runs after the sync
human-readable list of the same forks
